title: 1996 AHSME Problem 4
statement: Six numbers from a list of nine integers are \(7,\) \(8,\) \(3,\) \(5,\) \(9,\) and \(5.\) The largest possible value of the median of all nine numbers in this list is

solutions.text: The six specified values in order are \(3,5,5,7,8,9.\) Even if all three unspecified integers exceed \(9,\) the fifth entry of the full sorted list is \(8.\) This is attainable, so the correct answer is D.
hints: The median is the fifth number after all nine are sorted
To maximize the median, take each of the three unspecified numbers as large as needed
